an9.35:1.1: 35 seyyathāpi bhikkhave gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akkhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ
an9.35:1.3: yannūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyanti
an9.35:1.4: sā purimaṃ pādaṃ na suppatiṭṭhitaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā pacchimaṃ pādaṃ uddhareyya
an9.35:1.5: sā na ceva agatapubbaṃ disaṃ gaccheyya na ca akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyya na ca apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyya
an9.35:1.7: yannūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyanti tañca padesaṃ na sotthinā paccāgaccheyya
an9.35:1.9: tathāhi sā bhikkhave gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akkhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ
an9.35:1.10: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu bālo abyatto akkhettaññū akusalo vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ
an9.35:1.11: so taṃ nimittaṃ na āsevati na bhāveti na bahulīkaroti na svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti
an9.35:2.2: yannūnāhaṃ vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.35:2.3: so na sakkoti vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ
an9.35:2.5: yannūnāhaṃ vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.35:2.6: so na sakkoti vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ
an9.35:2.7: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ñāto bhaṭṭho ubhato parihīno seyyathāpi sā gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akkhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
an9.35:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gāvī pabbateyyā paṇḍitā byattā khettaññū kusalā visame pabbate carituṃ
an9.35:3.3: yannūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ apītapubbāni ca pāṇīyāni piveyyanti
an9.35:3.4: sā purimaṃ pādaṃ suppatiṭṭhitaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā pacchimaṃ pādaṃ uddhareyya
an9.35:3.5: sā agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyya akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyya apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyya
an9.35:3.7: yannūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyanti tañca padesaṃ sotthinā paccāgaccheyya
an9.35:3.9: tathā hi sā bhikkhave gāvī pabbateyyā paṇḍitā byattā khettaññū kusalā visame pabbate carituṃ
an9.35:3.10: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu paṇḍito byatto khettaññū kusalo vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ
an9.35:3.11: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti
an9.35:4.2: yannūnāhaṃ vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.35:4.3: so dutiyajjhānaṃ anabhihisamāno vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.35:4.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti
an9.35:5.2: yannūnāhaṃ pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca vihareyyaṃ sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeyyaṃ yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.35:5.3: so tatiyajjhānaṃ anabhihisamāno pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.35:5.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti
an9.35:6.2: yannūnāhaṃ sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.35:6.3: so catutthajjhānaṃ anabhihisamāno sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.35:6.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti
an9.35:7.2: yannūnāhaṃ sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.35:7.3: so ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ anabhihisamāno sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamma …pe… ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.35:7.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti
an9.35:8.2: yannūnāhaṃ sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.35:8.3: so viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ anabhihisamāno sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.35:8.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti
an9.35:9.2: yannūnāhaṃ sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.35:9.3: so ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ anabhihisamāno sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.35:9.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti
an9.35:10.2: yannūnāhaṃ sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.35:10.3: so nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ anabhihisamāno sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.35:10.4: so taṃ nimittaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti
an9.35:11.2: yannūnāhaṃ sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.35:11.3: so saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ anabhihisamāno sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.35:12.1: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu taṃ tadeva samāpattiṃ samāpajjatipi vuṭṭhātipi tassa mudu cittaṃ hoti kammaññaṃ
an9.35:12.2: mudunā cittena kammaññena appamāṇo samādhi hoti subhāvito
an9.35:12.3: so appamāṇena samādhinā subhāvitena yaṃyasseva abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññā sacchikiriyāya tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati satiāyatane
an9.35:13.1: so sace ākaṅkhati anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ ekopi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ bahudhāpi hutvā eko assaṃ …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyyanti
an9.35:13.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati satiāyatane
an9.35:15.1: so sace ākaṅkhati parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajāneyyaṃ
an9.35:15.2: sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an9.35:15.3: vītarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an9.35:15.4: sadosaṃ vā cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an9.35:15.5: vītadosaṃ vā cittaṃ vītadosaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an9.35:15.6: samohaṃ vā cittaṃ samohaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an9.35:15.8: vītamohaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ saṃkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ
an9.35:15.13: anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ
an9.35:15.17: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyyanti
an9.35:15.18: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati satiāyatane
an9.35:16.1: so sace ākaṅkhati anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyaṃ seyyathīdaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyanti
an9.35:16.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati satiāyatane
an9.35:17.1: so sace ākaṅkhati dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajāneyyanti
an9.35:17.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati satiāyatane
an9.35:18.1: so sace ākaṅkhati āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.35:18.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati satiāyataneti.
